description: Adds a font by its role: display (headlines), body, mono or accent. Either a Google Fonts family by name (google: true; Marsell fetches it), or the font's own file (WOFF2, TTF or OTF; a TTF or OTF is turned into WOFF2) from a public https url or its bytes. Headline and body set the brand kit; mono and accent are kept with the brand's files. For the families Marsell ships, fill_setup's display_font and body_font are enough. For files on the agent's own machine, get_upload_link gives an address to send them to from your shell, so nothing big passes through your messages.

data_base64.description: Or the file's bytes, base64 (as large as one MCP message carries, about 4 MB).

filename.description: Its file name with its extension, when you have one.

google.description: true: fetch the family from Google Fonts instead of sending a file.

role.description: display (headlines) or body set the brand kit; mono and accent are kept with the brand's files.

url.description: A public https address of the file. Marsell fetches it itself (public addresses only, up to 8 MB).

name: add_font
title: Add a font
